chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly substrate teaching: a systematic four-fold cosmic mapping (Four Days: Father/Third Ambassador/Pillar-Omophorus/Jesus the Radiance) paired with Four Nights (Land of Darkness/Matter/Worlds of Flesh/seventh dwelling = law of darkness). Each day/night has twelve hours mapped to cosmic entities (twelve gods, twelve virgins, twelve wisdoms, twelve shadows, twelve doctrines/zodiacs). Damage ratio is high (84.5%) — many segments are heavily lacunose but still preserve substrate vocabulary. Editorial fatigue is negative (substrate vocabulary actually decreases in second half but only because of damage). Frame formula at i=4 strips cleanly; brief beatitude-tail at i=29-30 ("every one who shall know them in faith") shows mild hortatory drift. The "doctrines" (ⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ) at i=80-84 are mapped as the twelve zodiacs of matter — a cosmic correspondence, not contemporary polemic. The "today" (ⲙⲫⲟⲟⲩ) at i=89 is a faint application marker but lacuna-bound.
